role: raw-coefficient sensitivity only; revision9 noise-aware discrimination is in results/prefill-design-round7/noise-screen.json; not statistical power
eligibility_rule: Freeze per-cell abs prediction gap >max(3*jitter[cell],25ms). Require BOTH mixed_burst and single_long groups with all constituent cells eligible. Average paired MAE gains within each block/group; both groups require mean gain >max(t(.95,4)*SD/sqrt(5),5ms) across five blocks. All8 cell regression guards retained. Unresolved or violated cross-block dependence prevents passing. Calibrated M0 and retained M1 required; M0 structural N/A.
resolution_rule: Before main, abs(expected delta)>3*calibration-only jitter; if an entire H2/H3 family is unresolved its identification claim is inconclusive. Stop main only when both families are unresolved. No cell replacement.

jitter_references.rule: Nearest absolute log-latency distance using raw-B2048 toy only; freeze before collection. Compute MAD across off trials per position, never pool request positions.
jitter_references.caveat: Noise-range proxies, not cell-specific measured variance or power. Out-of-range targets and mode differences must be reported; do not tune mapping from held data.

full_model_calibration_support.role: toy structural support, not fitted parameter certainty or measured validation
full_model_calibration_support.row_scope: foreground release through last foreground completion; background prep/drain excluded
full_model_calibration_support.weighting: each calibration cell has equal total squared row weight

gate: Before main trials, compare declared contrasts with calibration-only observer noise; no held-case swaps. Stop unsupported precision claims rather than retune the matrix.
